scope: Controlled acquisition of the two V2-B2S-approved Wave-1 replacement documents only.

documents.title: Acceptable Methods, Techniques, and Practices - Aircraft Inspection and Repair
documents.issuing_organization: U.S. Department of Transportation, Federal Aviation Administration

document_metadata.title: AC 43.13-1B - Acceptable Methods, Techniques, and Practices Aircraft Inspection and Repair (w/Change 1)
document_metadata.creator: Microsoft Word 8.0

documents.generation_reproduction_characterization: Digitally composed text and vector content with raster technical illustrations; fonts occur on 644 pages and direct image XObjects on 275 pages.
documents.style_independence_rationale: FAA aircraft-repair manual conventions, typography, line hierarchy, section/detail figures, inch dimensions, leaders, and repair-note layouts are organizationally and visually independent of the H2 NIST source family.
documents.family_suitability_evidence: The actual bytes contain dense aircraft sheet-metal repair and structural-detail drawings with mechanical edges, sections/details, dimensions and witness-like marks, leaders, callouts, notes, and line hierarchy. This was a source-level preservation check only; no labeling page was selected.

document_metadata.creator: Acrobat PDFMaker 15 for Word

documents.generation_reproduction_characterization: Digitally generated, font-bearing technical document; fonts occur on all 396 pages and direct image XObjects on only 10 pages.
documents.style_independence_rationale: FAA airport-engineering detail sheets use installation-detail layouts, cable/conduit and equipment geometry, aligned notes, leaders, foundation details, and FAA drawing conventions materially different from existing electrical material.
documents.family_suitability_evidence: The actual bytes contain dense airport visual-aid installation details with cable/conduit paths, connectors, light and support placement, underground junction boxes, grounding and foundation details, dimensions, leaders, and annotation-heavy layout rules. This was a source-level preservation check only; no labeling page was selected.
